sb_prompt: FIND OUT THE OTHER CALLER'S FAVORITE PRO BASEBALL TEAM AND WHERE IT'S HEADED THIS YEAR.  DO YOU AGREE WITH THE CALLER'S PREDICTION?
raw_output:
ParticipantA: Hello!
ParticipantB: Hi there!
ParticipantA: How are you doing?
ParticipantB: Pretty good, thanks. You?
ParticipantA: I'm okay, just had a long shift. How about you?
ParticipantB: Same here. Been busy at the shop.
ParticipantA: Oh, nice. So, what's your favorite pro baseball team?
ParticipantB: Hmm, that's a tough one. I'd say the Giants.
ParticipantA: Oh, the Giants? Nice. Where do you live?
ParticipantB: Out in the Bay Area, actually.
ParticipantA: Ah, okay. So you're a Bay Area local then.
ParticipantB: Yeah, born and raised here.
ParticipantA: Well, the Giants are great, but man, are they headed for anything good this year?
ParticipantB: Honestly? Probably not. We're kind of struggling right now.
ParticipantA: Oh, really? That's surprising. I think they're going to make the playoffs easily.
ParticipantB: Yeah, well, everyone says that, but I know a guy who's a scout out there. He thinks they're just rebuilding.
ParticipantA: Oh, really? Who is this guy?
ParticipantB: My cousin. He's a scout for the organization.
ParticipantA: Oh, wow. Okay, that makes sense.
ParticipantB: Yeah, he says the pitching depth is thin and they're waiting on a few rookies to step up.
ParticipantA: That's sad. I was pretty excited about them. But I do work in sports, sort of.
ParticipantB: Oh? Really? What do you do?
ParticipantA: I'm a supervisor at a factory, actually. Not sports, but I manage people.
ParticipantB: Oh, nice. That sounds intense.
ParticipantA: Yeah, it is. Managing people is hard. You have to balance getting things done with keeping them happy.
ParticipantB: Exactly. It's a lot like coaching a team. You gotta lead them, push them, but also know when to back off.
ParticipantA: True. Sometimes you feel like you're getting nowhere, you know? Like the whole team just isn't clicking.
ParticipantB: That happens all the time.
ParticipantA: Yeah. Like my cousin. He's a mechanic, right?
ParticipantB: Yeah, I'm a mechanic.
ParticipantA: Oh, really? So you're in my cousin's line of work!
ParticipantB: Yeah, same here. We fix cars.
ParticipantA: Oh, that's cool. So what does he think about the Giants?
ParticipantB: He told me yesterday. He says the owner is pushing too hard and the players are stressed out.
ParticipantA: That's exactly what I feel about my factory floor sometimes. Too much pressure, people start making mistakes.
ParticipantB: Yeah, I get that. My cousin says the same thing. He says if you don't give the guys space, they just break down.
ParticipantA: Wow. So you think the Giants are gonna suck this year?
ParticipantB: Yeah, I'm not optimistic. I think they'll finish near the bottom again.
ParticipantA: Oh, bummer. I was hoping for a turnaround.
ParticipantB: Me too, but if my cousin is right, it's gonna be a slow season.
ParticipantA: Well, at least you know what to expect, I guess.
ParticipantB: Yeah. Sometimes knowing the bad news is better than being surprised.
ParticipantA: True. I've learned that the hard way with my team.
ParticipantB: Yeah. Well, thanks for chatting.
ParticipantA: Yeah, you too. Nice talking to you.
ParticipantB: Bye!
ParticipantA: Bye!
